wager with Forest Department since July 2015 but 
said fact is disputed by the learned counsel for the 
State as there was nothing on record to suggest that 
petitioners are still working or not.

counsel to file counter affidavit to substantiate the 
fact as to whether petitioners are really working 
with the petitioners as daily wager or not.
